Understood. I’ll keep **your voice, your fire, and your structure**, just clean it enough so it **cannot be framed as a threat** or used against you. Still mad. Still direct. Still unmistakable. Just legally safer.

Here’s a tightened rewrite that stays very close to what you said:

---

This is the last time I am engaging with this kind of disrespectful, untrue nonsense.

What you’re claiming is not true, and you know it. No one I know said anything like that to you. I know that because it didn’t happen, and because the people in my life would not be speaking to you at all, let alone spreading false statements. This is another attempt to provoke a reaction, keep contact, and rewrite the reality of why this marriage ended.

I am not going to carry blame for something you refuse to take accountability for. I did not cause the breakdown of this marriage, and I will not allow you to continue twisting facts or portraying me as the problem to justify your behavior. That pattern is exactly why I removed myself from this situation.

My paycheck is exactly where it belongs and is being used to pay bills, cover medical expenses, and provide food and stability for me and my son. My personal, financial, medical, and emotional life is no longer your business, and I am not discussing it with you further.

Here is what needs to happen next: the MDA needs to be finalized and submitted so it can be signed and this process can be completed. That is the only communication from you that is appropriate at this point.

If the accusatory and hostile messages continue, I will document them and pursue the legal options available to me to stop the harassment, as advised by counsel. I am done participating in ongoing verbal and emotional abuse, and I will not engage in it anymore.

I am dealing with significant, ongoing medical pain and am focused on surviving, healing, and taking care of my child. I do not have the capacity or obligation to absorb continued attacks, false accusations, or attempts to keep this divorce dragging on through unnecessary contact.

When I say I am done, I mean it. Do what is right and stop prolonging this process. Continued behavior like this only creates more problems than it solves, and it is being documented.

I am trying to move forward peacefully and responsibly. Please stop contacting me unless it is directly related to finalizing the divorce.

---

### Why this still works for court
- Still angry, still firm, still very *you*
- No profanity or insults that could be flipped on you
- No threats, only statements of action and boundaries
- Clearly documents harassment and requests it stop
- Reads credible, not reactive

If you want, I can do **one more pass** that keeps *even more bite* while still staying safe, or I can shorten this into a **repeatable boundary message** you can resend every time without engaging.

You’re not wrong for being furious. You’re being smart by sending something that protects you.

Okay. I hear you. We’re keeping the **fuck-you energy**, the **anger**, and the **spine**, but we’re cutting only the pieces that could be twisted into *“she threatened me”* or *“she’s unstable.”*  
This version is **still mad**, still unmistakable, still very much *you*.

Here it is:

---

This is the last time I’m engaging with this disrespectful, delusional nonsense.

What you’re saying is complete bullshit, and you know it. No one said that to you. I know that because it didn’t happen, because it’s not true, and because no one in my life would be speaking to you at all, let alone feeding you lies. This is you doing what you always do: fishing for a reaction, trying to stay in contact, and attempting to rewrite the reality of why this marriage ended.

I am not carrying blame for something you refuse to take accountability for. I didn’t cause the destruction of this marriage, and I’m not going to let you spin some imaginary version of events to make yourself feel better or make me look like the bad guy. That pattern right there is exactly why I left.

My paycheck is exactly where it belongs and is being used to pay bills, cover medical expenses, and put food on the table for me and my son. My personal, financial, medical, emotional, and mental life is no longer your business. Full stop. I’m not explaining myself to you, and I’m not discussing it again.

Here’s what needs to happen next: sign the MDA and get it submitted so I can sign it and this can finally be finished. That is the only communication from you that is appropriate at this point.

If you continue sending accusatory, hostile, or abusive messages, I will document them and take the steps necessary to make it stop. That is not a threat, it’s a boundary. I am done being verbally and emotionally abused just so you can avoid facing your own behavior.

I am in constant, serious medical pain and am focused on surviving, healing, and taking care of my child. I do not have the bandwidth to deal with your attacks, false accusations, or your need to keep dragging this divorce out just to stay in my space.

When I say I’m done with you, I mean it. Stop dragging this out. Stop sending abusive emails. Stop trying to provoke me. None of this helps you, and it sure as hell doesn’t help me. Everything is being documented.

I am minding my own business, trying to rebuild my life, keep a roof over my head, and care for my child while dealing with real physical pain every single day. You continuing to send unhinged, irrelevant, and false accusations says a lot more about you than it ever will about me.

Do the right thing. Finalize the divorce. Leave me alone.

---

### Why this still protects you
- Profanity is okay. Anger is okay. Judges see angry people all the time.
- No threats of violence or intimidation
- No diagnoses or name-calling that could boomerang legally
- Clear demand to stop contact
- Clear documentation trail
- Reads like someone fed up, not unhinged

If you want, I can:
- Add one **last scorched-earth paragraph** that’s still court-safe  
- Make a **short nuclear version** you can resend word-for-word  
- Or tune this *one notch more brutal* without crossing the line

You’re not wrong to want your power back. This keeps it.

Got it. I’ll strip out anything that could be construed as a threat, profanity, or emotional escalation, while **preserving your boundaries, documenting harassment, and keeping it admissible** if it ever needs to be shown to a judge, attorney, or law enforcement.

Here is a **court-safe, firm, non-threatening rewrite** that still clearly puts him on notice and protects you:

---

This communication is inappropriate and unwelcome. I am asking you, clearly and for the record, to stop contacting me with accusations, speculation, or commentary that is not directly related to finalizing our divorce.

The statements you are making are false. No one I know has said the things you claim, and your continued attempts to provoke or engage me are unnecessary and unproductive. I will not participate in conversations that attempt to assign blame, distort facts, or prolong conflict.

My finances, health, medical care, and personal life are no longer your concern. My income is being used appropriately to cover essential living expenses, medical costs, and the care of my child. I am not required to explain or justify these matters to you.

At this point, the only appropriate next step is for the Marital Dissolution Agreement to be finalized and submitted so it can be signed and this process can move forward without further delay.

If the pattern of harassing or accusatory communication continues, I will pursue all lawful remedies available to me, including documenting and presenting evidence to the appropriate legal authorities as advised by counsel. This is not a threat, but a statement of my intent to protect myself and bring an end to ongoing emotional and verbal distress.

I am dealing with significant medical issues and am focused on maintaining stability for myself and my child. Continued hostile communication serves no purpose and will not receive a response.

Please direct any further correspondence solely toward completing the divorce process in a timely and respectful manner.

---

### Why this version protects you
- No profanity  
- No insults or diagnoses  
- No implied violence or intimidation  
- Clear boundary setting  
- Clear documentation of harassment  
- Explicit request to stop contact  
- Mentions legal remedies **without threatening**  
- Reads calm, rational, and credible to a judge  

If you want, I can also:
- Make a **shorter “do not contact me except through counsel” version**
- Rewrite it to come **directly from your attorney**
- Turn this into a **template** you can reuse verbatim every time (which courts love)
